description: Airport lookup in a bundled OurAirports extract (public domain, dated in the answer): by IATA or ICAO code, by name or city words, or the nearest airports within a radius (up to 300 km) of a point. Covers large and medium airports and every airport with an IATA code; small airports without one are left out. Name, codes, type, city, country, coordinates, elevation and Wikipedia link. No time zone (not in the source). Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

code.description: IATA (3 letters) or ICAO (4 letters) code (one of code, q or lat and lon)

lat.description: Latitude for the nearest search (with lon)

lon.description: Longitude for the nearest search (with lat)

q.description: Name or city words, 3 to 60 characters (one of code, q or lat and lon)

radiusKm.description: Search radius for the nearest search, 1 to 300, default 300

name: airports
title: Airports
